description:
In the far north, a vast island seems to dwarf continents below. Greenland, dominates the top of the world map. 
Even if we strip away the cartographic illusion, it’s the largest island on Earth—immense by any honest measure. 
From north to south, Greenland stretches about 1,650 miles—enough distance to span the US from the Canadian border to the Gulf Coast.
